about:
# Magely Forever

**Magely** is a lightweight buff manager for mages, inspired by **PallyPower**. It tracks
*Arcane Intellect* (and *Arcane Brilliance*), *Amplify Magic* and *Dampen Magic* across your party
or raid and lets you rebuff with a single click.

This is the **World of Warcraft: Forever** edition (client 1.60.1, Interface `16001`).

> **[Buffy](https://github.com/Spotnick2/Buffy) is the new consolidated version.** It combines
> Magely, Priestly and Wildly in one addon on the same engine, and picks Mage, Priest or Druid
> buffs for the character you log in. It starts with fresh settings rather than importing
> Magely's, so disable Magely while you use it, or you get two buff windows.

![Magely buff window in a group](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Spotnick2/Magely/main/docs/screenshots/magely-01.png)

*Earlier-build screenshot. The cooldown-request pane shown here is not in the current Forever
version; the buff window has since gained additional controls.*

> **Playing TBC Classic Anniversary?** Install **v0.1**, the last release for that client. It stays
> available on CurseForge for the Anniversary game version. The Anniversary line is no longer
> being developed.

Magely shares its engine and window with **Priestly** and **Wildly** through the
[LibGroupBuffs](https://github.com/Spotnick2/LibGroupBuffs) library, so a fix to one reaches all
three.

---

## Features

* **One row per group, per buff**, colour-coded by how many people are missing it, with the lowest
  remaining timer on the bar.
* **One-click buffing.** Left-click casts Arcane Brilliance, right-click buffs the first person
  missing Arcane Intellect. No targeting.
* **Works before you have Arcane Brilliance.** While you only know Arcane Intellect, left-click
  simply buffs whoever needs it. Nothing is wired to a spell you do not have.
* **Amplify and Dampen Magic when they matter.** Each has its own setting: always, when someone in
  the group already has it, or by instance - with a list of Forever's dungeons and raids to tick.
  Both rows can show at once.
* **Per-member popover.** Mouse over a row for the full list with range indicators and per-person
  click casting.
* **Group-aware.** It follows party and raid changes, subgroups, and pets.
* **Reagent tracking.** The Arcane Powder count, once you know Arcane Brilliance.
* **Your spec's look.** The header, title and icon follow Arcane, Fire or Frost.
* **Window controls.** Minimize without closing, lock its position, adjust opacity and choose
  which side the member popover opens on.

---

## Usage

Use the header **-** to minimize to the title bar and **+** to restore. Requests in
combat wait until combat ends. Minimized state lasts for this session; `/reload`
or logging in expands the window again. **X** closes the window.

In the popover, **? beside the class icon** means spell range is unknown.
**? instead of a timer** means the buff cannot be read and there is no cached reading.

```
/magely          toggle the window
/magely show     force open
/magely hide     close
/magely config   open the options panel
/magely reset    reset the window position
/magely pos      why the window is where it is
/magely help     full command and click reference, then the spell names Magely reads
```

The window opens on its own when you join a group. On other classes Magely shows nothing and
says nothing, unless you type `/magely`, which answers with one line.
Settings and window position persist between sessions.

**Row colours:** green = everyone has it · yellow = some missing · red = nobody has it ·
grey `?` = buff state cannot be read right now (the client hides aura data during combat, so
Magely keeps counting down from the last reading instead of guessing).

---

## Installation

### CurseForge (recommended)

Install through the CurseForge app and enable it in game.

### GitHub and Wago

Download from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Spotnick2/Magely/releases/latest)
or [Wago Addons](https://addons.wago.io/addons/magely). Both include the required libraries.
The GitHub release includes `release.json` for compatible addon managers.

### Manual

Download the release zip and extract it so the folder lands at:

```
World of Warcraft/_forever_/Interface/AddOns/Magely/
```

---

## Good to know

**Pet eligibility:** hunter and warlock pets are excluded from Arcane Intellect
tracking and targeting. Amplify and Dampen keep their existing pet eligibility.

Magely uses single-target Arcane Intellect until you learn Arcane Brilliance. It learns buff
durations from live auras and relearns them when the client build changes. The cooldown-request
pane in the screenshot is from the older Anniversary edition and is not available in Forever.
If a Forever instance is missing from the Amplify/Dampen list, please report its in-game name.

The window's text uses a font for your client's language, so names on a Korean or Chinese client
show as text. A Korean or Chinese name on an English client still shows as boxes, because the
English client has no font for it.

Forever can hide aura data during combat. Magely uses its last observation and shows `?` if no
reliable reading is available. Window movement, closing and minimize/restore requests made during
combat take effect after combat ends.

If the game refuses Arcane Intellect with "A more powerful spell is already active" out of
combat, because something stronger is already on that member, the row's single-target click
skips them for up to 30 seconds: both clicks until you learn Arcane Brilliance, then the right
click. Entering combat, or a buff being removed or updated on them, can end it sooner. Magely
can't tell in advance whose buff is stronger, so the first cast on that member still fails, and
when everyone left has been refused the click casts nothing. You can still pick them yourself from
the popover.

---

## Feedback

Open an [issue on GitHub](https://github.com/Spotnick2/Magely/issues) or leave a comment on
CurseForge. Include whether the problem happened in combat, and the lines `/magely help` ends
with: your locale, game build, Magely and library versions, and the spell names Magely reads from
the client, with any it could not read flagged. On a non-English client they are what tells a
missed buff from a name Magely cannot read. Typing
`/console scriptErrors 1` in game shows Lua errors that the client otherwise hides.

releases.name: Magely Forever 1.1.2
releases.notes:
### Fixed
- When the game refuses Arcane Intellect with "A more powerful spell is already active" out of
  combat, because something stronger is already on that member, the row's single-target click
  now skips them instead of trying them again: both clicks until you know Arcane Brilliance, then
  the right click (the Brilliance click is unchanged). The refused cast teaches this whether it
  came from the window, an action bar or a macro, as long as it was the rank the row casts (your
  highest); a macro casting a lower rank that gets refused doesn't. The skip lasts up to 30
  seconds; entering combat, or a buff being removed or updated on them, can end it sooner. If
  everyone left has been refused, the click casts nothing. You can still pick a skipped member yourself from the
  popover. This has passed offline tests and was checked in game with Buffy's Fortitude on the
  same library; it hasn't been checked in game for Arcane Intellect yet.

### Changed
- Updated the embedded LibGroupBuffs to r39 (was r36), which adds this refusal memory (#97).
  LibGlass is still r13.

releases.name: Magely Forever 1.1.1
releases.notes:
### Changed
- **Checked on game build 1.60.1.70959**, the current WoW: Forever client. Nothing Magely relies on
  changed in this build, so there is nothing to do after updating.
- **The window's text follows your client's language.** On a Korean or Chinese client, names
  and labels in the buff window used to draw as empty boxes; they now use the client's own font.
  English and other Latin clients, and Russian, look exactly as before. (A Korean or Chinese
  name on an English client still shows boxes: the English client has no font for it.)
- Updated the embedded libraries to LibGroupBuffs r36 (was r34) and LibGlass r13 (was r11).

releases.name: Magely 1.1.0
releases.notes:
### Added
- `/magely help` now ends with a spell report: your locale, game build, Magely and library
  versions, and the name of every spell Magely matches buffs against, as your client gave it.
  A name Magely could not read from the client is flagged and counted. Please include these
  lines when reporting a problem, especially on a non-English client.

### Changed
- Updated the embedded LibGroupBuffs library to r34. LibGlass stays at r11.

releases.name: Magely 1.0.6
releases.notes:
### Added
- Releases are also available on GitHub (with addon-manager metadata) and Wago Addons.
- Header controls to minimize the window and restore it without closing it.
  Requests in combat apply when combat ends. Minimized state is session-only.

### Changed
- The buff window and popup now sit below normal UI panels, including bags.
- Updated the embedded libraries to LibGroupBuffs r31 and LibGlass r11.

### Fixed
- Help distinguishes unknown spell range (`?` beside the class icon) from unreadable
  buff state (`?` instead of a timer).
- Hunter and Warlock pets no longer count as missing Arcane Intellect or appear
  as targets for that buff. Other pet types retain their existing eligibility.
  Amplify Magic and Dampen Magic eligibility is unchanged.
